summary: Iteration 349 covers 4 new widget features: chat booking, rep takeover, site crawl, and file upload. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_widget_live_booking.py (15 tests) — all pass. Regression: tests/test_website_widget.py + tests/test_website_widget_jessi.py = 16/16 pass. Frontend flows verified via Playwright: Inbox live-chats-strip renders card for a live sid, tapping opens /webchat/{sid}, join → send rep message → save-as-lead → Open contact/Text thread links → leave → end all wired. Widget editor Doors/Jessi/Look/Install tabs all expose the new testids (widget-chat-booking-on/label/notify-reps, widget-section-crawl, widget-crawl-url/start, widget-avatar-image + upload/manual-toggle/url, and Install tab 'Booked in chat' stat tile). Widget restored to defaults (chat on/booking_on/notify_reps true, label 'Chat now', page_rules [], avatar/icon urls empty).

minor.issue: When the uploaded PNG bytes are malformed/truncated (PIL raises 'broken data stream'), the server returns HTTP 502 with body '{"detail":"Could not store that image, try again"}'. That should be a 4xx (400) client error, not 502. It also produces '[SERVER ERROR 502]' entries in backend.err.log. Repro: POST a body with non-decodable image bytes. Valid PNGs work fine.

When chat.booking_on is false, /book returns 400, but if the visitor session hit the outer send throttle first the response reads 'Please wait a minute before sending again.' instead of 'Booking is turned off'. Both are 400, but the booking-off check runs after the rate limit, so the caller cannot distinguish the two cases. Minor.

verified_flows: Booking: chat/start → visitor msg 'test drive this week' -> offer_booking true + Jessi reply; slots tz America/Denver, 3 days x N slots, kinds len==3; book test_drive returns {booked:true, booking.kind='Test drive', when contains ' at '}; second book -> 400 'already have a visit booked'; bad time 03:00 -> 400 'not open'; missing phone -> 400; rep detail has contact_id/conversation_id/booking.task_id set.
Booking off: PUT doors.chat.booking_on=false → book returns 400; restored to true after.

Rep takeover: GET /widgets/chats/live shows sid with mode=jessi, turns 1, visitor_here=true (after visitor GET), store_name; POST /join -> mode human, agent set, system message 'joined'; POST rep message -> role rep with who+uid; visitor GET shows mode human, agent, rep line with who, and NO role 'note' messages; visitor msg while human -> reply null, mode human; rep_unread resets after GET /widgets/chats/{sid}; POST /lead -> contact_id+conversation_id + role 'note' 'Saved as a lead' (rep-only, visitor GET excludes notes); /by-conversation/{cid} returns summary while open, null after close; /leave -> mode jessi + 'stepped away'; /end -> status closed; visitor GET status closed; visitor POST message after end -> 400 'ended'; unknown sid -> 404; unauthenticated /live -> 401; rep-scope /live -> 200.

Site crawl: bad url -> 400; rep POST /crawl -> 403, rep GET /crawl -> 200; manager POST crawl imonsocial.com -> {status:'running'}, poll every 3s finishes 'done'; draft.facts/specials arrays present, pages>=1, no em/en dashes in facts/notes; apply with 2 facts -> added_facts=2; re-apply same -> added_facts=0 (dedupe); cleanup DELETE both fact ids.
Upload: valid PNG -> 200 {url:/api/images/..., original_url, thumbnail_url, avatar_url}; GET url returns image/*; non-image (text/plain) -> 400; rep -> 403.

Frontend inbox: [data-testid=live-chats-strip] renders; [data-testid=live-chat-{sid}] tappable; navigates to /webchat/{sid}. Webchat screen: status-line/join/messages/input/send/leave all present; join enables composer; sending rep msg shows gold 'You' bubble; save-lead-toggle + name+phone(5005550043) + lead-save reveals webchat-open-contact and webchat-open-thread; leave returns status to 'Jessi is answering'.

Widget editor tabs: Doors {widget-chat-booking-on, widget-chat-booking-label, widget-chat-notify-reps}; Jessi {widget-section-crawl, widget-crawl-url, widget-crawl-start}; Look {widget-avatar-image, widget-avatar-image-upload, widget-avatar-image-manual-toggle, widget-avatar-image-url after toggle}; Install tab displays 'Booked in chat' stat tile.
Regression: pytest tests/test_website_widget.py tests/test_website_widget_jessi.py -> 16 passed (widget key rotates on the first file; re-read from GET /widgets/{id} afterwards).
action_items: (minor) /api/widgets/{id}/upload should return 400 (not 502) when Pillow rejects the image bytes (log tag: '[Widget] upload failed: broken data stream when reading image file').
(minor, optional) In /w/{key}/chat/{sid}/book, evaluate booking_on before the outer rate-limit so callers get 'Booking is turned off' consistently.
critical_code_review_comments: Widget key rotates whenever tests/test_website_widget.py runs (test_rotate_key_kills_the_old_script). Always re-read via GET /api/widgets/6ab72996c248f5420bf0a14a before using the public /w/{key}/... endpoints — never cache. Current key after this run: EWL5Pjgk (may rotate).
chats/{sid} rep view marks read for the joining rep — good. Visitor GET correctly hides role 'note' messages; verified.
Crawl job stores raw draft in widget_crawls; apply is idempotent (added_facts=0 on retry). Consider capping fact text length in the LLM draft.
Upload endpoint should also validate MIME server-side beyond Pillow decode to short-circuit obviously bad content-types with 415/400.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all documented testids present; end-to-end webchat flow works)

rca of the issue: No functional bugs. Only two minor RCA items: (1) upload endpoint should map PIL 'broken data stream' to 400 instead of leaking a 502 (with body still JSON detail); (2) rate-limit check runs before booking_on check in /book, making the off-state error message ambiguous when the same session hit the rate limit.
